From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>

Subject: Re: Data Processing Addendum for onboarding

Irene / team / Marta — attaching our proposed redline (NorthBridge_DPA_Redline_v2.docx). Summary of the key redline points:

1) Subprocessors: we will provide a current subprocessor list and commit to 30 days notice for additions. We cannot agree to prior approval for every new subprocessor; suggested compromise: prior notice + right to object for material changes with defined remediation window.

2) PHI handling: Redwood can accept a narrow PHI appendix that maps to our HIPAA security controls. We will require a minimal configuration checklist be completed by NBH to verify which flows contain PHI.

3) Data retention/erasure: propose retention buckets (12/36/indefinite with documented justification) rather than a single static term. We also propose an export/erasure runbook to satisfy regulatory audits.

4) SCCs & International transfers: we will include the standard EU SCC module and a flow for on-prem/private deployments where data residency is required.

5) Evidence: SOC 2 summary (attached) + SOC2 report available under NDA; we can provide an SOC2 access request process.

6) Signature sequence: we propose Redwood to send a DocuSign envelope with two required signatures: (1) Authorized NBH procurement sig (procurement@northbridgehealth.com) and (2) NBH Legal/Privacy sign-off (Alex Jenkins). Redwood’s signer will be an authorized officer (Irene / Marissa as needed). If NBH requires procurement-first execution, we accept that flow but request DocuSign routing instructions and the exact signer names.

Please review; Marta — the attached redline highlights items where we ask for language adjustments or workflow clarifications. If we can get alignment on the subprocessor notice and PHI appendix this week, we can route for signature Friday.

Attachments: NorthBridge_DPA_Redline_v2.docx; NBH-SOC2-summary-2027.pdf

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

Karthik / Irene — thanks for the quick turnaround and the redline. A few clarifications from NBH Procurement/Legal:

- Procurement prefers the DocuSign envelope to be initiated by Redwood but with procurement as the first signer. We will use procurement@northbridgehealth.com (shared mailbox) for signature routing.
- For subprocessors, NBH’s policy requires an escalation window of 14 days to review material changes; the 30‑day notice is acceptable, but we need the 14‑day escalated review window explicitly called out.
- PHI appendix: we can accept a narrow appendix. NBH will complete the configuration checklist by EOD Monday; can you confirm the checklist fields?
- SOC2: we need the full report under NDA. Please send the NDA link (or HubSpot/DocuSign flow) to procurement@northbridgehealth.com.

We are targeting signature by next Thursday. Could you push the redline back with the 14‑day window and copy the procurement mailbox on the DocuSign envelope draft?

Best,
Marta
